e6: pin ↔ anti-stud is not a compatible pair
notes: Element IDs come from the inventory page (p.11). Parts whose IDs match no catalogue entry (including head, torso, legs, helmet, antenna, mudguard) are new lego-<id> types; the visor uses the existing lego-4163306.

The pictures in steps 1-4 show the 2x6 plate upside down. I assumed the 2x2 round plates (4211475) push into its underside by their pin, and the black wheel holders sit on them. The bar plates (4210660) and 1x2 plates (4211398) go on the top studs.

Step 6 shows more than its single arrowed piece. I assumed the grille tile and two 1x2 studded plates are added there, with one more studded plate on the grille side. That matches the inventory count of 3x 379401 and 1x 241201 and the later steps.

I assumed the 'left' mudguard (b15) carries the windscreen slope and the clip/handlebar, and the 'right' mudguard (b16) carries the grille tile and flag pole. Each mudguard sits on one bar plate and one 1x2 plate.
The minifig is built first (p.2) and sits on the plate between the mudguards. This is shown as contact, since it is not locked. His hands rest on the handlebar (contact).
The wheel is a tire pressed on a hub; the hub fits an axle on the wheel-holder plate and spins. The tire/hub port names are invented to fit the allowed port kinds.
The 'attach' override target for wheel copies is 'b9:axle.1', the template endpoint.
